words.TITLE: Spending
words.DETAIL: Drop a bank export (CSV or Excel) into a folder Jarvis may look in, then ask in chat, for example "how much did I spend on food last month?". Jarvis adds the numbers up with plain code and shows a small table on screen. The table is never read aloud, never remembered and never sent anywhere. Account and card numbers in the file are hidden.
words.PC_ONLY: Set up on the PC: Settings, Spending. The columns of a new bank file are checked there, once.
words.NEEDS_SETUP_ON_PC: Open Jarvis on the PC to check the columns of this bank file (Settings, Spending). It takes a minute and is remembered.
words.STARTER_NOTE: These are starter categories. Change the words to suit the shops you use.
words.HIDDEN_COLUMNS_NOTE: A column that looks like an account or card number is not shown, and cannot be used.
words.TABLE_GONE: This table is no longer kept. Ask again to see it.
words.SPOKEN_LINE: I have put it on your screen.
words.DROPPED_LINE: Here is the table. (Jarvis's own summary sentence used a figure that is not in the table, so it was left out.)
words.CAV_ONCE: {n} rows were in more than one file and were counted once.
words.CAV_ONCE_ONE: 1 row was in more than one file and was counted once.
words.CAV_SKIPPED: {n} rows were left out: totals, closing balances and rows without a date or an amount Jarvis could read.
words.CAV_SKIPPED_ONE: 1 row was left out: a total, a closing balance or a row without a date or an amount Jarvis could read.
words.CAV_UNCAT: Uncategorised: {n} rows, {amount}. Add words for them in Settings, Spending.
words.CAV_UNCAT_ONE: Uncategorised: 1 row, {amount}. Add a word for it in Settings, Spending.
words.CAV_CURRENCIES: This file has more than one currency. Each is added up on its own and nothing is converted.
words.CAV_HIDDEN: Account and card numbers in the descriptions are hidden.
words.CAV_PENDING: A bank that changes a shop's name between a pending and a posted export can make one row count twice.
words.CAV_REFUNDS: Refunds are already taken off the categories above.
words.CAV_TRANSFERS: Transfers between your own accounts are left out of spending.
words.CAV_DATES: {n} rows had a date that did not fit the saved date order and were left out. If that looks wrong, check the columns again on the PC.

sign_sentences.negative_out: Rows like 'SHOP -45.10' will be counted as money spent.
sign_sentences.positive_out: Rows like 'SHOP 45.10' will be counted as money spent, and a minus sign as money coming in.
sign_sentences.debit_credit: Amounts in the Debit column will be counted as money spent, and the Credit column as money in.
sign_sentences.drcr: Rows marked Dr will be counted as money spent, and rows marked Cr as money in.

errors.needs_setup: Open Jarvis on the PC to check the columns of this bank file (Settings, Spending). It takes a minute and is remembered.
errors.no_header: Jarvis could not find the row with the column names. Open Jarvis on the PC and choose it there (Settings, Spending).
errors.unchecked: Jarvis could not check this file for account and card numbers, so it showed nothing.
errors.too_big: This file is too big. Export a shorter period (at most 5 MB or 50,000 rows).
errors.empty_period: No spending was found in that period.
errors.pc_only: Set up on the PC: Settings, Spending. The columns of a new bank file are checked there, once.
